welcome.description: This is a virtual companion you can talk to anytime. Whether you want to share your feelings, ease some stress, or simply have a light conversation, it will listen patiently and respond in a gentle, relaxed way. Sometimes, simply having a conversation can be a meaningful kind of companionship.
